lead: Amrish Puri was an Indian stage actor, born on 22 June 1932 in Jalandhar.
He died on 12 January 2005 in Mumbai at the age of 72.
He is associated with work such as Tridev and Baadshah and has been recognised with Sangeet Natak Akademi Award and Filmfare Award for Best Supporting Actor.
This profile collects the Amrish facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.
